name: Polearm Training lets a polearm wield melee abilities at an extended range (#6906)
contract: Polearm Training ranks 802299/803832/807892 are item-independent passives (EquippedItemClass -1) whose
dummy Effect 0 carries $s1 = 2/3/5 yd (basePoints 1/2/4). Player::GetMeleeAbilityRangeBonus returns that
aura amount while a polearm is in the main hand, and Unit::GetSpellMaxRangeForTarget adds it for
SPELL_DAMAGE_CLASS_MELEE spells whose SpellRange row is the melee row (Combat Range, 0-5 yd, flags 1).
Centurion Strike 802738 is such a spell (DmgClass Melee, 0-5 yd, basePoints 274 weapon percent).
Spell::CheckRange then accepts meleeRange + MELEE_RANGE (1.0 yd) + the bonus, so the guardian must be
able to land Centurion Strike on a target 9.5 yd away whereas a two-handed sword is rejected at the same
distance. That distance sits between the sword ceiling (meleeRange + 1 = 6 yd, 8 yd when leeway applies)
and the rank 3 polearm ceiling (meleeRange + 1 + 5 = 11 yd).
Only the native melee-range gate is pinned here; the client's own range indicator is client-side and is
Fixture: guardian level 80 on the default location facing the spawn axis, Sunfury Blade 30394 in the main
hand for the control, Jeweled Halberd 30396 plus all three Polearm Training ranks for the fix.
